subject: Request: Trial credit extension after lapsed sandbox — Auratech
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@auratech.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sana Patel <sana.patel@auratech.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T09:13:00-08:00
Subject: Trial expired — one-time credit request for POC evaluation

Hi Naomi / Karthik,

Quick one: our sandbox tied to auratech@auratech.com expired yesterday and we still need a short window to finalize embedding quality checks and streaming integration for the POC scheduled next month. We burned through the test tokens faster than expected while validating streaming + long-context behavior.

Can Redwood do a one-time short extension (30 days) or a temporary credit top-up so our engineers can finish the evaluation? Ideally 150k token-equivalent would get us to the demo milestone. We can sign a light MOU if required.

I attached the trial usage snapshot so you can see where the spend concentrated (embeddings + streaming). If you need a PO or procurement contact, loop in Sana — she handles procurement.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Sr. Product Manager — Auratech Systems
liam.oconnor@auratech.com

Attachments: auratech-trial-usage-report.csv (CSV summary)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@auratech.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sana Patel <sana.patel@auratech.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Trial expired — one-time credit request for POC evaluation

Hi Liam — thanks for the detail and the usage file.

We can make a one-time exception: Redwood is willing to provision a 150k token credit valid for 30 days from the issuance date to let your engineers complete the POC. A couple of notes:
- This top-up is a one-off promotional credit; once it expires normal billing resumes.
- We'll provide a short MOU that captures the credit amount, validity period, and simple acceptance criteria for the demo.
- We need procurement to confirm a PO or sign the MOU so our finance team can authorize the issuance.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll circulate a 1-page MOU (PDF) for signature.
2) Karthik — can you confirm there are no special quota changes needed on the infra side (e.g., model pins, stream concurrency)?
3) Sana — if procurement can confirm PO cadence and any required billing contact, we’ll route the paperwork.

Attaching the proposed MOU draft and the usage snapshot for the internal review.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: auratech-credit-term-mou.pdf, auratech-trial-usage-report.csv

From: Sana Patel <sana.patel@auratech.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@auratech.com>
Cc: procurement@auratech.com
Date: 2026-11-13T08:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Trial expired — one-time credit request for POC evaluation

Hi Naomi — thanks for the quick reply and for drafting the MOU. A couple procurement questions before we sign:
- We need confirmation this is a credit (no invoice) and that post-credit usage will be billed at your public list rates unless we upgrade.
- Our finance team typically requires a short SOW or PO line that references any credits applied; can you provide a reference number we can include on our PO?
- Do you have a contractual lead time for activating the credit once the MOU is signed? We need the credit to be live by Nov 22 to stay on track.

Appreciate it — I’ve CC'd procurement.

Best,
Sana Patel
Procurement Manager — Auratech Systems
procurement@auratech.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-17T10:04:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Trial expired — one-time credit request for POC evaluation — internal approval request

Team — forwarding the thread. Requesting finance sign-off to approve a one-off 150k token promotional credit for Auratech. Key points below:
- Credit: 150k token-equivalent; validity: 30 days from issuance.
- Purpose: complete embeddings & streaming tests for POC scheduled early Dec.
- Risk: low; customer is in active POC and procurement will sign MOU/PO.
- Billing impact: promotional credit only; we will not issue an invoice against the credit. Post-credit usage will be billed normally.

David — can you confirm and provide a PO reference template we can pass to Auratech? I attached an approval sheet with estimated cost-offset and the internal account notes.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sales Director | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: approval-sheet.xlsx

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T15:05:00-08:00
Subject: Credit top-up applied — next steps and DocuSign link

Hi all — quick update and confirmation.

1) We've issued the one-time 150k token promotional credit to Auratech; it is live on account auratech@auratech.com and will be valid for 30 days from today (issued 2026-11-20). Please find the short confirmation file attached (auratech-topup-confirmation.txt).
2) There is no invoice for the credit. Post-credit usage will be billed at Redwood's standard hosted rates unless you request a committed plan.
3) For procurement, here is a PO reference you can include: RW-CREDIT-DL-2026-1183. That reference will let finance map any future PO/SOW to this deal.
4) DocuSign link for the 1-page MOU: https://docusign.net/auratech-mou-sign — Please sign within 72 hours so we can keep the credit in place and ensure the POC deadlines are met.

Karthik — we left concurrency and model pins unchanged; if you need throttle increases, let us know and we'll make a short exception during the 30-day window.

Liam / Sana — glad we could move quickly on this. Reach out if you need help with rate limits or model selection while you run the tests.

Best regards,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
